candidate_sentences.text: Rannakalda reached 91 apartments sold out of 113, Botanica Lozen reached 95% construction readiness with 9 of 16 houses sold, and the group acquired the Spordi site for a planned 56-apartment development with total investment of €15 million.

verified_key_information_units.information: The Soodi 6 project (Kodulahe VII etapp) has the detail plan issued, with 66 units (62 apartments and 4 commercial premises) planned; construction is expected to commence at the end of Q2 2025 and complete in 2026.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report - Group CEO's Review and Arco Vara's Active Projects table

verified_key_information_units.information: Arco Vara acquired a development site at Spordi 3a, 3b in Tallinn during Q1 2025; the project comprises 56 apartments (7,600 m² gross building area) with a total investment of EUR 15 million; pre-sales will begin in Q2 2025, and handover is scheduled for the end of 2026.

candidate_sentences.text: New loans of €3.090 million included €2.190 million to finance the Spordi 3a and 3b land acquisition and €900 thousand for Rannakalda construction.

Rannakalda reached 91 apartments sold out of 113, Botanica Lozen reached 95% construction readiness with 9 of 16 houses sold, and the group acquired the Spordi site for a planned 56-apartment development with total investment of €15 million.
Pre-sales and construction for Spordi are planned for Q2 2025.

verified_key_information_units.information: The Botanica Lozen project in Bulgaria reached 95% readiness for the first phase (16 houses) by the end of Q1 2025; nine of the 16 houses had been sold by quarter-end, with full completion expected by the end of Q2 2025.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report - Group CEO's Review and Operating report section

verified_key_information_units.information: Preparatory work for the Arcojärve project is progressing according to plan; the detailed plan approval is targeted in the coming months, with construction scheduled to begin at the end of 2025.
Detailed planning for the Kodulahe development at Lammi 6 advanced significantly in Q1 2025; construction is anticipated to start in approximately two years from the report date.
The Merivälja Kuldlehe exclusive cluster house development comprises five apartments; two have been sold to date, with three remaining vacant as of 31 March 2025.

details.completeness_justification: The candidate summary adequately covers the core material meaning of K1 (Q1 2025 revenue and profit figures), K2 (net loans and interest rate change), K3 (Estonian market revitalization signs), K4 (Rannakalda sales progress), K6 (Spordi 3a/3b acquisition and project details), and K7 (Botanica Lozen progress). However, it omits core material for K5 (Soodi 6 project details), K8 (Arcojärve project status), K9 (Kodulahe development planning), and K10 (Merivälja Kuldlehe cluster house status). While most high-importance items are covered, the missing items represent significant project updates, leading to a 'Generally yes' rating.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. All statements are logically connected and support the overall narrative of improved financial performance in Q1 2025. There are no self-contradictions, logical gaps, or organizational issues. The summary flows logically from revenue growth to segment performance, profitability metrics, cash flow, balance sheet changes, and market context. While there is a minor arithmetic relationship between segment revenues and total revenue (S2, S6, S7, S8), the candidate does not claim these are exhaustive additive components of the same total, so this is not treated as a contradiction per evaluation guidelines. No unnecessary repetition materially reduces clarity.
